nodes.description: Memory and concentration complaints are common (13/17), but testing usually shows mild deficits; executive dysfunction and disinhibition are described, and dementia is late and uncommon.

nodes.description: Mice lacking both endothelin-1 degrading carboxypeptidases degrade endothelin-1 more slowly, have arteries more reactive to it and develop higher blood pressure on a high-salt diet with endothelin-1 injection. This is not a CARASAL model; it tests the endothelin arm of the proposed mechanism.
Dysphagia in 10 of 15 patients, with dysarthria in some; attributed to brainstem involvement.

evidence.reference_title: Expanding the Clinicoradiologic Phenotype of the CTSA-Associated Small Vessel Disease CARASAL: A Comparison With CADASIL.
evidence.snippet: Patients with CARASAL frequently reported extracerebral symptoms such as sicca (13/17, 77%), muscle cramps (13/18, 72%), and dysphagia (10/15, 67%).

nodes.description: Endothelin-1 is a potent vasoconstrictor. In mice lacking both cathepsin A and its homolog SCPEP1 activity, endothelin-1 is degraded more slowly, arteries constrict more to it and blood pressure rises on a high-salt diet; single deficiency is milder. Extending this to CARASAL hypertension and arteriopathy is an inference.

nodes.description: Excess endothelin-1 is proposed to result from reduced degradation by mutant cathepsin A. Only one part of this has been observed in patients: striking endothelin-1 immunoreactivity in white matter astrocytes at autopsy. Reduced degradation and a systemic excess, which the vascular and muscle arms below assume, are inferred, not measured.

evidence.reference_title: Cathepsin A-related arteriopathy with strokes and leukoencephalopathy (CARASAL).
evidence.snippet: In the patients, striking endothelin-1 immunoreactivity was found in white matter astrocytes, correlating with increased numbers of premyelinating oligodendrocyte progenitors.

nodes.description: Patients have smaller extraocular rectus muscles and less intraorbital fat than controls, and many report muscle cramps. The authors of the largest cohort propose that endothelin-1, which impairs muscle myogenesis and causes atrophy in mice and stimulates adipocyte lipolysis, links these features. No study has tested this in CARASAL.

evidence.snippet: Interestingly, ET-1 is also implicated in the regulation of skeletal muscle blood flow36 and was previously shown to impair skeletal muscle myogenesis and induce muscle atrophy in mice,37 with increasing circulating levels of ET-1 being associated with muscular fibrosis.

nodes.description: The only known CARASAL variant, c.919C>T p.(Arg307Cys) (NM_000308.4), equivalent to c.973C>T p.Arg325Cys in older numbering. It is a founder variant in the Netherlands and has also been found in unrelated Chinese and Italian-Brazilian patients. The affected arginine lies on the protein surface in an AlphaFold model. Heterozygous carriers do not have galactosialidosis, and the effect of the variant on cathepsin A carboxypeptidase activity has not been reported, so the node binds the enzyme's activity without a direction.
